settings.title: Full ingredient list
settings.content: Squalane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Coffea Arabica (Green Coffee) Seed Oil, Paullinia Cupana (Guarana) Seed Extract, Citrus Aurantium Amara (Bitter Orange) Peel Oil, Hedera Helix (Ivy) Leaf Extract, Tocopherol (Vitamin E). Fragrance-free. 96% naturally derived.

settings.title: How to use
settings.content: Warm 4–6 drops between your palms and massage into clean skin using upward strokes — thighs, tummy, arms, anywhere you want a firmer look. Best on slightly damp skin, morning or night. Sinks in fast.
